info.name: Get short energy data for a device

params.name: device-id
params.description: The ID of the device

params.name: fromTs
params.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp >= fromTs. Default, if not specified = now minus 1 hour.

params.name: toTs
params.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp < toTs. Default, if not specified = 1 hour after fromTs.

params.name: filter[group]
params.description: When set to 'phases', the energy data entries will be collapsed to reflect the phases.grouping configuration of the device.

params.name: convert[energy]
params.description: Converts energy data to kilowatt hours or kilowatts.

params.name: fields[energy]
params.description: \'+pf\' will append calculated power factor to the returned energy data objects. Note that filter[group]=phases can't be combined with fields[energy]=+pf.

items.docs: Retrieves short-term energy data for a specific device

info.name: Get first short energy data entry

params.name: device-id
params.description: The ID of the device

params.name: filter[group]
params.description: When set to 'phases', the energy data entries will be collapsed to reflect the phases.grouping configuration of the device.

params.name: convert[energy]
params.description: Converts energy data to kilowatt hours or kilowatts.

params.name: fields[energy]
params.description: \`fields[energy]=+pf\` will append calculated power factor to the returned energy data objects. \`timestamp\` will return just the timestamp attribute in the returned data object. +pf and timestamp are mutually exclusive and can't be combined, i.e. fields[energy]=+pf,timestamp will result in an error. The fields[energy] query string options can't be combined with filter[group]=phases.

items.docs: Returns the first received short energy entry from the device.

params.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp >= fromTs. Default, if not specified = first long energy entry.

params.description: Unix timestamp, seconds since epoch. Returns data with timestamp < toTs. Default, if not specified = 7 days after fromTs.

params.name: granularity
params.description: Granularity of the data.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Required if granularity >= hour. Irrelevant (and ignored) if granularity is < hour.

params.name: fields[energy]
params.description: \'+pf\' will append calculated power factor to the returned energy data objects. Note that filter[group]=phases can't be combined with fields[energy]=+pf.
